info.name: Getting Started with Passport Global Order API

description.content:
Introduction

Passport Global's API is designed to allow for quick integration to begin selling and shipping internationally. It offers endpoints for general shipping-related functions, including rate requests and shipping label generation.

Prerequisites

  • Passport Global API is a REST-like API. All methods must be called using HTTPS.
  • Authentication and identification is done by providing an API key on every request as a custom HTTP header "X-Access-Token".
  • All requests are made using the POST method.
  • The API key is provided by our onboarding team. For more details see registration and authentication.
  • The API uses JSON formatting for requests and responses.
  • Environments
    • Testing Environment: api-stg.passportshipping.com/v3
    • Production Environment: api.passportshipping.com/v3

Registration and Authentication

During the onboarding or integration process, our Onboarding team will create an account for your organization and provide the API key to your designated point of contact, which is typically a member of the operations, development team, or one of the founders.

Making Your First Request

A typical first request is to obtain a shipping rate. Use the /rate endpoint, providing necessary details like the addresses (address_to and address_from), parcel dimensions, and item descriptions.

Use the documentation below to see an example request body for a rate request

Response Handling

Successful responses return a 200 status code

Handle error responses (for example 401 Unauthorized, 404 Not Found) according to the provided error messages for each endpoint provided below.
